correctness.rationale: Sun’s theorem shows no failure before j. For j, Kummer’s base-p carry count is exactly 1 if j+floor(bj/p^r)>=p, otherwise 0. Since p divides bj+1 and the other prime factors divide the binomial to full denominator multiplicity, delayed failure is equivalent to one carry and p² not dividing bj+1. CRT residue class counting gives the exact M formula; a <3 error per j yields the uniform <=2/p^(r-1) error, and harmonic sums tend to log 2. Independent Legendre-valuation and direct binomial computations agreed in 12 configurations.

value.rationale: Sun explicitly proposed investigating the first nondivisibility index f(a,b), for which only example values and general upper bounds were offered. The result classifies the complete first-eligible index across every invertible coefficient below each prime power p^r (r>=2), gives a finite exact census and a uniform 1-log 2 asymptotic for the genuinely delayed proportion; the complementary log 2 law is a motivated structural distribution, not an arbitrary finite slice or trivial reformulation.
